method: United Arab Emirates depth cycle 1: the UNESCO ICH state page and the Al Azi element page, the World Heritage state page, the ISO 639-3 registration for Arabic, and Arabic/English mirror pages for language presence, cuisine and culture. No population, speaker or share number is recorded, and an element whose submitting-State list was not read in this cycle is stored as a deferred record rather than labelled national or shared.
